summary: "The Treatment of Armenians in the Ottoman Empire" by Arnold Toynbee et al. is an official report presented in 1916. Commissioned by British Parliament and compiled by Viscount Bryce and Toynbee, this 742-page volume assembles over 100 eyewitness accounts, dispatches, and letters documenting atrocities during the early period of the Armenian and Assyrian genocides. Despite Turkish denials, scholars verified its authenticity before publication, establishing the evidence as genuine beyond question. (This is an automatically generated summary.)
